label: bluegecko-3v1-comet-catcher-9
people: [gecko]thebluegecko (34 in the record header; the ledger says OS 48), Armada, the west strip; his commander seen once, at B5 at 2:35
our_side: Three seats under one Opus 5.5 medium player (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium, Claude Code 2.1.283): t1 G1 Cortex (purple), t2 H8 Armada (dark blue), t3 G4 Armada (teal); hands Jev jev-latest (jev-1.13.0) as the pianist, with the packet decompression on; realtime, the user's lobby; no commander seat
summary: Three seats under one Opus 5.5 medium player filled our half fast (30 extractors at 7:35, 44 by 10:35) and showed three to six times his seen army from 7:00 to 11:00, but the lead was held for 'a later push on his base' while Blitz and Stout groups ground against his forward Janus, Stout and Beamer block at C6 and B1, and the constructors stayed east of the middle by the packet's rule. His counter-push took seven middle spots at 11:45-12:43; our gathered groups broke it about evenly (counted once, 5.4k of his for 4.9k of ours), while the report's seat-summed trade told the player it was winning 2:1. The 13:24 'spending the lead' went piecemeal into Beamer nests, and his factory was never seen in 20 minutes. Out of sight he had gone to tier 2: Bulls from 14:54 (24 distinct seen) killed our Stouts and a 36-Pounder ball in pieces, then overran the three bases from 17:19; the last commander died at 20:16. thebluegecko afterwards: the game was over by 15:00 for lack of metal, and we 'need to hold more of the map'.

root.what: The first window (7.1k army against 1.3k seen, his raid block broken at C6, our groups in his half at B1 and C6, our half nearly full by 8:16) was held for 'a later push on his base' while every constructor stayed east of the middle by the packet. The map beyond the middle was never taken, our extractors stopped at 44 by 10:35, and his economy outgrew all three seats (24 Bulls from 14:54). The 'not enough metal, hold more of the map' reading is thebluegecko's (a person); the minute is the reader's.

their_play: thebluegecko (Armada, west strip, commander at B5 at 2:35) raided early with Rovers and Blitzes and held extractors on middle spots (the player's 4:18 note: 'spot_46/49 where enemy extractors block ours'; 7 of 35 bad-site refusals of ours were at E5). He did not meet our three seats in the open. He held a forward block at C6 (Janus, Stouts, 13 Beamers seen from 8:25) and light turrets at B1, which out-traded our raiders and Stouts from 7:00 to 11:00. At 11:45 he pushed about 16 Janus and Stouts into E5/E6 for seven of our middle spots; that block was traded off about evenly by 13:07. Meanwhile he went to tier 2 out of sight: Bulls from 14:54 (24 distinct seen), rebuilt Beamer nests and a Mauser (the ledger). The Bulls worked in pairs through D2-E2 into t1's base (17:19-18:30), then F8 into t2's (19:08) and G4 into t3's (19:26-20:16). His factories were never in our sight.

bears_on.note: This game is the lesson's first case. Asked about the Bull switch, he answered that the game was over by 15:00 on metal. The trade counted once (behind in every phase but one) and 24 Bulls from 14:54 agree with him.
We held about half the map (44 of 80 spots at 10:35) and stopped, with the constructors barred from his half. Against him, half was not enough.

The seen lead at 7:10 and 13:24 was never converted, against game 5's converge-and-kill. Note that the lead was partly a floor of sight: his seen army was small, and the trade counted once ran against us.
The player's own notes: 14:13 'the spot_59 push arrived piecemeal'; 15:42 '3 Bulls beat our Stouts in ones'.
Nothing was reclaimed; 9.7k to 15.5k of wrecks were offered late, and 29k of ours died west of the middle, where he could eat it.
His Bulls beat a tier-1 army of Stouts, Janus and Pounders; our own tier 2 stood only at 16:12.
Pounders used as the offensive ball against Bulls lost 34 for 195 metal.

The scout cars crossed at 2:20 and saw his commander at B5, but the first raider mass crossed only at 5:43. The first building of his to die was a light turret at D5 (6:07, the map's middle); the first in his own corner was at B1 at 7:37.

tools: python over record-*.jsonl (enemy sightings; deaths counted once by unit id)
lens.existing_review: none (no review.md; the match directory's posing-review.md and decompression-review.md were read and built on)
lens.caveats: There is no truth file, so his army, extractors and income are floors from our sight. The case that his economy outgrew three seats rests on the person's word and on 24 distinct Bulls seen, not on a measured income. minutes, analyze_match, floor, raid_ledger and hands_window read only record-0 (t1), so t2 and t3 were run through scratch directories linking record-N as record-0. pro_baseline compares single seats with a 1v1 pool: t1 (G1 Cortex) is uncarded, t2 needs --all-starts, and its pressure rows are blank without a truth start. The match directory holds no review.md, but it has posing-review.md and decompression-review.md (2026-09-27), and this row builds on both. Where it differs: the posing review's estimate of 'at least 46 metal a second' used the seat-summed 37,188; counted once, it is 12,396. The chat lines' speaker is '?' in chat.jsonl and 'player 0' (the opponent's seat) in bot.log; the attribution to thebluegecko is the record header's, the ledger's and L-mex-game-over's. The event def ids are offset by one from the header's unit_defs ids, and the reader's script corrected for this. impedance_sweep counts one session replacement. The loss does not rest on a since-fixed defect alone: the Bull phase leaned on the reach-less odds, and the player's belief that it was ahead leaned on the triple-counted trade, but the person put the decision on metal before 15:00.

open_questions: Where was his base? His commander was seen once, at B5 at 2:35, and no factory of his was ever seen. What were his extractor count and income at 13:00?
Was the 6:16 pick (21 Blitzes walked back from 4 Rovers and 10 Blitzes at C6) a misjudgement, or right given what stood unseen behind them?
How much of our 29k lost west of the middle, and of his own wrecks, did he reclaim?
t3's income reads 16.9 flat with 8 extractors from 11:00 to 18:00: a stalled seat, or a sample artifact?
Were the 35 'site was bad' extractor refusals his extractors on our middle spots, or our three seats' lists colliding?
